BiblicalUsage: The Ancient of days is the title Daniel gives to God on His throne, and this Aramaic word means venerable, aged, enduring. Daniel saw the Ancient of days sit, His garment white as snow and His hair like pure wool, and the Son of man came to Him, and judgment was given to the saints of the most High.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Ancient of days is the comfort of every believer, because the God who was before all things will still be on the throne when all things end. The beasts rise and fall, but the Ancient of days remains, and I hold that His kingdom is the one that will never pass away.
